mapper.select: select sysNoticeUser.id, sysNoticeUser.title, sysNoticeUser.notice_type, sysNoticeUser.sender_name, sysNoticeUser.sender_date, sysNotice.read_status from sys_notice sysNotice inner join sys_notice_user sysNoticeUser on sysNotice.id = sysNoticeUser.notice_id and sysNoticeUser.logical_delete = 0 where sysNotice.logical_delete = 0 and sysNoticeUser.receiver_id = #{receiverId}
